text.description_html:
RK International CK-1G, Frosted Globe Glass Cabinet Door Knob

A perfect addition to romantic ranch homes, the Smoked Glass Globe Cabinet Knob made by RK International features a frosted white coloring that will stand out against dark wood cabinets or softly accent modern white kitchens. The rosette for this cabinet door knob is available in 4 finishes including a traditional oil rubbed bronze and satin nickel (pictured). It comes packaged with all necessary mounting hardware.

Specifications and Features of the CK-1G Smoked Glass Cabinet Door Knob:

  • Material: glass with a brass rose
  • Diameter: 1-1/4"
  • Projection: 1-5/8"
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
